companies.name: Atexxo
companies.tagline: Explosion-proof and future-proof: your partner in IECEx, ATEX, and Inmetro equipment. Explosion-proof products suitable for use in Zone 1 and Zone 2 and/or Zone 21 or 22
companies.description:
Atexxo Manufacturing is an international company specialized in the design and production of explosion-proof mobile devices with ATEX and IECEx certifications. Headquartered in the Netherlands, Atexxo converts premium Apple and Samsung devices — such as iPhones, iPads, and Galaxy Tabs — into certified versions for safe use in hazardous areas, maintaining all original equipment functionalities, including 5G, NFC, cameras, wireless charging, and Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity.

Atexxo products are certified for ATEX Zone 1 and 2 (gas explosion risk) and Zone 21 and 22 (dust explosion risk), with international IECEx and UKCA certifications, as well as INMETRO certification available for selected models. All devices preserve the complete user experience, including apps, interface, performance, and ecosystem of the original device, without loss of performance.

Designed specifically for critical industries such as oil and gas, petrochemical, offshore, and pharmaceutical, Atexxo devices are ideal for connected workers, Industry 4.0, digital twins in hazardous areas, and safe photo and video capture in dangerous environments.

companies.name: Blinda
companies.tagline: Count on Blinda and its portfolio of solutions for explosive atmospheres
companies.description:
For over 60 years, Blinda has been a national reference in explosion-proof (Ex) electrical equipment, serving with excellence the oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, and mining sectors. Its portfolio includes junction boxes, control panels, push buttons, cable glands, signaling devices, and a complete line of certified connections and accessories.

With INMETRO, IECEx, and ATEX certifications, Blinda is the only company in Brazil authorized to use CEAG components in its projects, ensuring an international standard of quality and safety. All products are manufactured with high-resistance materials — copper-free aluminum, stainless steel 304/316L, and glass fiber reinforced polyester (GRP) — ensuring IP66/W protection and a temperature class from -60 °C to +110 °C.

Located in Votorantim (SP), Blinda is part of the Polar Components Group, offering complete solutions in Ex equipment for explosive atmospheres, with specialized technical support and custom manufacturing to meet the most rigorous industry specifications.

companies.name: Dropsafe
companies.tagline: Global leader in dropped object prevention. Mitigating the risks of falling objects to make work environments safer
companies.description:
Dropsafe is the global leader in dropped object prevention, partnering with companies in high-risk sectors such as energy, oil and gas, mining, chemical, maritime, and renewables. With over 20 years of experience, it develops specialized solutions — nets, barriers, slings, and fastening systems — to prevent objects from falling in industrial environments, ensuring safer operations and strengthening safety culture.

Unlike active solutions that depend on daily human intervention, Dropsafe adopts a passive prevention philosophy: a single installation protects all assets 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, functioning independently of human action. Its products are manufactured from SUS 316 stainless steel and high-strength polycarbonate, designed for severe offshore environments with temperatures ranging from -40 °C to 500 °C.

The patented Trisafe™ technology — a triple-action carabiner with automatic locking operable with one hand — eliminates human error and sets a new safety standard. With global certifications including DNVGL-RP-F107, ABS DOPP+, API RP 2D, NORSOK, and ISO 9001, Dropsafe protects people and equipment in the world's most demanding environments, backed by $10 million product liability insurance.

companies.name: Eaton
companies.tagline: We make what matters work: we help manage electrical energy safely and sustainably, improving people's lives and the planet
companies.description:
Powering Business Worldwide. Lighting and connectivity solutions for hazardous areas and aggressive environments — reliability, efficiency, and safety under the most severe conditions. Eaton combines innovation, global certification, and cutting-edge engineering to deliver complete lighting and connectivity solutions for the most demanding hazardous areas in the world. In Brazil, Polar Group represents Eaton solutions for hazardous areas: certified LED luminaires and high-performance pin & sleeve connectors for environments with explosion risk, flammable gases, and combustible dust.

With efficacy up to 162 lm/W, energy savings of 20% to 90% compared to HID and fluorescent technologies, and a lifespan of 50,000 to 100,000 hours, Eaton luminaires offer instant start, field-replaceable drivers, and custom optics for each project, plus smart features — Brightlayer Industrial Lighting Control, Bluetooth Low Energy, and integrated sensors for intelligent lighting management.

Safety in hazardous areas goes beyond lighting: GHG51 Pin & Sleeve connectors ensure insulation, sealing, and total safety at every connection, with IEC 60309 performance and global certifications — UL844, UL1598, CSA, IECEx, ATEX, CE, ABS, NSF, and Inmetro. Industry-leading reliability and superior thermal management for the harshest environments in global industry.

In addition to explosion-proof lighting, the Eaton electrical portfolio — circuit breakers, panels, and protection — completes the range of energy solutions represented by Polar Group.

companies.name: Oliver Valves
companies.tagline: Reliability under pressure — high-quality valve solutions for instrumentation, subsea, and pipelines. Absolute precision in instrumentation and flow control for over 40 years
companies.description:
Oliver Valves is a British manufacturer of instrumentation and pipeline valves for the oil and gas, petrochemical, and energy sectors. Specializing in needle valves, ball valves, manifolds, check valves, and Double Block and Bleed (DBB) valves, the company provides high-precision flow control solutions for critical applications.

With over 40 years of valve engineering, Oliver Valves is recognized for the reliability and durability of its products in the world's most demanding environments. The Oliver Twinsafe brand — a pioneer in the DBB pipeline valve for over 25 years — offers large-diameter DBB ball valves with true double isolation: more safety, fewer leaks, and less maintenance, in new or existing pipelines.

About the DBB concept (Double Block and Bleed): it is an arrangement with two isolation valves in series (primary and secondary) and a bleed valve between them, allowing flow to be blocked at both ends and pressure in the central cavity to be relieved.

companies.name: StopDropp

companies.description:
StopDropp develops hand tools specifically designed to prevent drops during work at height. Founded in 2005, with headquarters in Houston, Texas (USA) and Dewsbury, West Yorkshire (UK), the company is a global reference in tethered tools, tools at height, and tools aloft.

It serves the oil and gas, petrochemical, construction, mining, utilities, wind energy, and telecommunications sectors, aiming to reduce occurrences of dropped objects. It is a member of organizations dedicated to fall prevention in offshore and onshore sectors.

Its product ecosystem includes: tether cords and spirals with explicit working load limits (WLL) for all types of tools; wearable anchor points (belts and vests with reinforced attachment points) and structural ones; bags and backpacks with magnetic or buckle closures, non-conductive and with multiple attachment points; as well as carabiners, connectors, tool wraps, and complete kits. All products have EN 13157, ANSI/ISEA 121, ASME B30.20, and API RP 2D certifications, with load tests performed by third-party certifiers and full traceability through serialization.

products.name: Tool Bags
